title: [WIP] Refactor and reorganize official documentation structure
body:
## Documentation Restructuring Plan

Reorganizing official website documentation according to the new standardized structure that better aligns with the codebase:

### Phase 1: Understand Current State
- [x] Explore existing documentation structure in `content/docs/`
- [x] Review codebase structure in `packages/spec/src/`
- [x] Understand Fumadocs navigation system (meta.json files)

### Phase 2: Create New Structure (7 Main Sections)
- [ ] Create `01-concepts/` - Core concepts (from common & existing concepts)
  - [ ] what-is-objectql (ObjectQL concept)
  - [ ] schema-definition (JSON/YAML schema definition)
  - [ ] architecture (System + Driver + UI architecture)
- [ ] Create `02-core-protocol/` - Core protocol layer (from ql & core)
  - [ ] objectql-syntax (Query, Mutation, Subscription)
  - [ ] type-system (Scalar, Object, Interface, Union)
  - [ ] error-codes (Zod Error Map)
  - [ ] security-model (ACL, RLS)
- [ ] Create `03-system-contract/` - System-level contract
  - [ ] plugin-lifecycle (PluginContext, onInstall, onEnable) ✨
  - [ ] event-bus (System Events, Hooks)
  - [ ] metadata-registry (Metadata registration)
  - [ ] logger-interface (Unified logging)
- [ ] Create `04-ui-protocol/` - Frontend/Interaction protocol
  - [ ] widget-contract (FieldWidgetProps - widget.zod.ts) ✨
  - [ ] view-schema (Layout, Page, Component)
  - [ ] interaction-flow (Actions, Navigations)
  - [ ] theme-variables (Styles & theme)
- [ ] Create `05-driver-interface/` - Driver development guide
  - [ ] storage-driver (Memory, Excel, Redis, SQL)
  - [ ] auth-provider (Authentication drivers)
  - [ ] file-system (File system abstraction)
- [ ] Create `06-api-reference/` - Auto-generated reference docs
  - [ ] zod-schemas (Auto-generated from .zod.ts)
  - [ ] typescript-types (Core Interface definitions)
  - [ ] cli-commands (CLI usage)
- [ ] Create `07-guides/` - Scenario-based tutorials
  - [ ] building-plugin ("How to build an ObjectStack plugin")
  - [ ] custom-widget ("How to create custom Field Widget")
  - [ ] deploy-strategy (Docker, Serverless deployment)

### Phase 3: Migrate Existing Content
- [ ] Map existing docs to new structure
- [ ] Update meta.json files for navigation
- [ ] Update cross-references and links

### Phase 4: Verification
- [ ] Test documentation site builds
- [ ] Verify all links work
- [ ] Review navigation flow

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> 参考这个目录，规范重新整理官网文档
> 
> /docs
> ├── 01-concepts              # 核心概念 (对应 packages/spec/src/common)
> │   ├── what-is-objectql     # ObjectQL 理念：SQL/NoSQL/Files 的统一虚拟化
> │   ├── schema-definition    # 如何用 JSON/YAML 定义数据 (Schema First)
> │   └── architecture         # 架构概览：System + Driver + UI 的三角关系
> │
> ├── 02-core-protocol         # 核心协议层 (对应 packages/spec/src/ql & core)
> │   ├── objectql-syntax      # ObjectQL 语法规范 (Query, Mutation, Subscription)
> │   ├── type-system          # 类型系统 (Scalar, Object, Interface, Union)
> │   ├── error-codes          # 标准错误码定义 (Zod Error Map)
> │   └── security-model       # 权限与访问控制 (ACL, RLS)
> │
> ├── 03-system-contract       # 系统级契约 (对应 packages/spec/src/system)
> │   ├── plugin-lifecycle     # 插件开发规范 (PluginContext, onInstall, onEnable) ✨重点
> │   ├── event-bus            # 系统事件总线 (System Events, Hooks)
> │   ├── metadata-registry    # 元数据注册机制
> │   └── logger-interface     # 统一日志接口规范
> │
> ├── 04-ui-protocol           # 前端/交互协议 (对应 packages/spec/src/ui)
> │   ├── widget-contract      # 控件契约 (FieldWidgetProps - widget.zod.ts) ✨重点
> │   ├── view-schema          # 视图描述协议 (Layout, Page, Component)
> │   ├── interaction-flow     # 前端交互动作定义 (Actions, Navigations)
> │   └── theme-variables      # 样式与主题变量规范
> │
> ├── 05-driver-interface      # 驱动开发指南 (对应 packages/spec/src/driver - 假设)
> │   ├── storage-driver       # 存储驱动接口 (Memory, Excel, Redis, SQL)
> │   ├── auth-provider        # 认证驱动接口
> │   └── file-system          # 文件系统抽象层
> │
> ├── 06-api-reference         # 自动生成的参考文档
> │   ├── zod-schemas          # 从 .zod.ts 自动生成的 JSON Schema 文档
> │   ├── typescript-types     # 核心 Interface 定义
> │   └── cli-commands         # CLI 工具链使用说明
> │
> └── 07-guides                # 场景化教程
>     ├── building-plugin      # "如何从零开发一个 ObjectStack 插件"
>     ├── custom-widget        # "如何为 React/Vue 封装自定义 Field Widget"
>     └── deploy-strategy      # 部署策略 (Docker, Serverless)
> 


</details>
